prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 团队周报看板（第 34 周） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "成员" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 54px
  col 3: header "本周完成" · longest unbreakable word 58px · one-line width 679px
  col 4: header "下周计划" · longest unbreakable word 44px · one-line width 934px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总第 34 周各成员的工作状态、本周成果与下周计划，帮助团队识别进展、风险和阻塞。","reading":"读者先按成员逐行查看状态，再横向关联本周完成与下周计划；也会纵向扫描状态以定位风险和阻塞。长文本换行后应保持每一行仍易于辨认。","groups":["成员与状态共同构成每行的快速索引。","本周完成与下周计划是一对时间相邻的叙述列，需要并排比较；下周计划的单行内容更长。"],"keep_intact":["成员姓名","状态图标与状态文字","数字、百分比、英文缩写及专有名词等不宜拆开的内容"],"may_wrap":["本周完成和下周计划中的中文叙述可在自然语义边界换行；同一行中较短的单元格可利用另一叙述列产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [67, 75, 260, 317] · table 720×580px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [67, 75, 255, 322] · table 720×580px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [67, 75, 290, 287] · table 720×604px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"成员姓名、状态图标和文字均保持完整，索引列紧凑且便于纵向扫描；两列叙述并排，较长的下周计划获得更多空间，行与行的边界清楚。","problems":"陈嘉禾的下周计划末行只剩“边界”，赵一鸣的末行也较短；吴桐的本周完成将“反馈”拆到两行，阅读节奏略受影响。","cause":"下周计划宽317px，本周完成宽260px，部分句子恰好在词语或句末附近换行。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"保留了清晰的成员和状态索引，叙述列比例适合计划内容较长的情况；表头完整，行高与r2A相同，没有单词内部拆分。","problems":"与r2A相比，下周计划仅多5px，陈嘉禾和赵一鸣的短末行仍在；本周完成更窄，吴桐的“反馈”仍跨行，整体改善有限。","cause":"本周完成由260px减至255px，下周计划增至322px，但增量不足以改变主要行高或消除短末行。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"本周完成较宽，部分成果叙述更舒展；成员和状态仍完整，表头清晰。","problems":"下周计划明显拥挤：林思远多占一行，吴桐末行仅剩“表”，多处词语跨行；较宽的本周完成没有带来相应收益，整表也更高。","cause":"本周完成增至290px，同时下周计划缩至287px，与后者更长的内容不匹配。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"plan-plus","widths":[67,75,245,332],"change":"在r2B基础上再向下周计划转移10px，检验能否改善短末行及长计划的换行，同时观察本周完成是否新增行高或不自然断词。"},{"name":"balanced-refine","widths":[67,75,270,307],"change":"在r2A与r2C之间适度增加本周完成宽度，检验能否改善“反馈”等断行，同时保留足够的计划列空间。"},{"name":"plan-priority","widths":[67,75,230,347],"change":"探索更明显地优先分配空间给最长的下周计划，检验计划列能否减少行数，并评估较窄的本周完成对行高和可读性的影响。"}]}
